decisions.rationale: Blind initial view: the full wayyiqtol-Piel divine-speech frame opens one census-ransom procedure from condition through amount, equality, sanctuary allocation, memorial purpose, and repeated kpr closure; the new speech at 30:17 confirms the endpoint.
decisions.translation_notes: kpr npš can carry ransom/atonement senses; pqd denotes counting or mustering; terumah is contribution/offering; zikkaron is a memorial before Yahweh. These strengthen internal cohesion but do not independently authorize the seam.
decisions.cross_reference_notes: Exod.38.25-28 narrates the counted silver and sanctuary use. The census/plague association in 2Sam.24 is conceptually material but does not narrow this unit.

decisions.rationale: A repeated full speech formula introduces a distinct cultic object and washing procedure, progressing from making and locating the basin to users, occasions, death warning, and enduring-statute closure; another speech reset at 30:22 confirms the endpoint.
decisions.translation_notes: kiyyor may be basin or laver; English can obscure repeated washing and death-warning language; huqqat olam denotes an enduring statute rather than a new event.
decisions.cross_reference_notes: Exod.38.8 supplies construction; Exod.40.7,30-32 placement and enacted washing; Lev.8.6 related priestly washing.

decisions.rationale: A full speech formula frames one complete anointing-oil instruction: ingredients and measures, formulation, uses, holiness effect, generational designation, imitation/use restrictions, and cut-off sanction; 30:34 changes speech, substance, and use.
decisions.translation_notes: Choice spices, myrrh, aromatic cane, cassia, compounded-perfumer language, holiness terms, unauthorized-person language, and cut-off sanction require phrase-level translation care but do not blur the endpoint.
decisions.cross_reference_notes: Exod.37.29 records production; Exod.40.9-15 and Lev.8.10-12 enact sanctuary and priestly uses.

decisions.rationale: A clear new divine-speech act with a new imperative, aromatic ingredients, incense product, sanctuary placement, imitation restriction, and its own cut-off closure forms a complete parallel procedure.
decisions.translation_notes: Ingredient identifications are uncertain or tradition-mediated; equal/proportional parts and seasoned/blended are debated renderings. These affect translation, not the boundary.
decisions.cross_reference_notes: Exod.30.1-10 supplies altar-use context; Exod.37.29 records manufacture; the oil/incense pair remains preserved as a parent relation.

overall.blind_initial_view: All four units are internally complete and bounded by strong Hebrew discourse and procedural signals.
overall.comparison_result: The stored strategy and R1 boss ruling concur with the independently formed judgment and did not change it.
overall.source_limit: Morphology and lemma attributes were evidence and lookup hints, never boundary or lexical authority.
